gaps.note: no held document states the weight of the EMIT04-10: the drawing gives none and the overview and brochure give none per model.
gaps.wanted: the maker's specification sheet for the EMIT04-10 with its unit weight.

gaps.note: no photograph of this model is held. The sheet says "BLACK CHASSIS" and its section outlines are yellow and blue; the brochure's page 3 photographs of 1U G3+ units (a later generation than the 2015 sheet) show a black chassis and module, yellow (A) and blue (B) lettered tiles, light blue buttons with white symbols and a lit blue-violet screen. The buttons' light blue and the tiles' two hues are taken from them and are borrowed, not measured on this model. The chassis hex, the unlit display's dark blue and the breaker handles' pale colour are stand-ins.

the sheet draws a round 12.9 point at the left end of the controls face with the earth symbol under it, and names no part. It is placed as a ground screw on a washer (common/ground-screw-washer@1, 11.0); the size and the kind of fixing are not stated.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned detail or a photograph of the controls end.

gaps.note: the meter is hot-swappable but no held document draws it apart from the faceplate, so no bay and no module component stand for it; the ports, display and buttons are placed on the face.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or photograph of the module and its slot.

gaps.note: the sheet draws a plate above each C13 and beside each C19 with a lever, crosses, a triangle and a ring, the outlet's grip (the overview lists "Integrated IEC outlet grips prevent accidental disconnects"), and no figure dimensions them. They are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned detail of the grip or a photograph.

gaps.note: the sheet prints the numbers of the four C19s and the end numbers of each C13 run only; the C13s between take their numbers from the run (B4 to B1 left to right on the sheet, A4 then A3).
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the cord face.

gaps.note: the plan shows two bands along the rear and front edges and six screws, and no figure gives their relief. Only the screws are drawn.

the quick start (P-164000314_2, July 2014, page 2) names a serial or EMP port, an Ethernet port, a USB port, a reset button and a daisy chain port for the module, and its drawing is too small to tell which of the sheet's stacked pair of RJ-45 sockets is the serial port and which the daisy chain. The upper is drawn as the serial port and the lower, under the chain symbol, as the daisy chain; the order is an assumption. The quick start allows four units on a chain where the product overview (PA155003EN, 2018) says eight.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the module with its labels, or the module's operations manual.

gaps.note: the sheet prints the chain, network and USB symbols, the small legend above the network port and the Eaton wordmark on the module, as outlines a millimetre or two high; none is drawn (the wordmark is the `logo-zone` region). The ground point drawn here is a screw on a washer where the sheet draws an empty circle.

breakers.note: drawing - "CIRCUIT BREAKERS (2) 20A 2-POLE UL LISTED"; the one-line diagram puts each of A and B across L1 and L2.

capability.note: drawing - "CURRENT, POWER AND ENERGY METERING FOR INPUT & BRANCH": `metering-scope: branch`, `outlet-switching: false`.

chassis.note: drawing - 42.9 high, 203.2 deep, 482.6 over the ears; the body reads 444.4 between the ears' inner edges, so it is 444.5 and each ear 19.05. "BLACK CHASSIS"; the hex #1f2022 is a stand-in. No weight is stated by any held document (gaps: weight).

dcim.note: the input is one `nema-l6-30p` power port (eaton/g3-cord-l6-30p@1); each C13 outlet is an `iec-60320-c13` power outlet and each C19 an `iec-60320-c19` power outlet fed by it, named as printed.

ears.note: drawing - as the EMIT03-10: an L flange with a slot at each end of the controls face. The library's generic ear stands for them (`chassis.ears`).

front.note: drawing - mm from the body's left and top, as seen from the front. The meter module is the same as the EMIT03-10's (plate 21.9 to 166.7 across; serial and daisy-chain ports at 33.6; network port at (57.2, 13.4); USB-A (57.2, 25.1); buttons at 96.8 and 153.8; display at (110.2, 4.2)). Breaker A's plate stands at 188.5 across and 21.2 down and breaker B's at 250.7, each 59.2 by 19.4 with two mounting screws 9.0 above it. Outlets A1 and A2 are C13s centred 364.6 and 389.1 across and 19.5 down, in a yellow-edged block 348.7 to 401.8 across; their labels A1 and A2 at 344.9 and 405.3. The module's labels and the left-hand earth point are as the EMIT03-10's.

input.note: drawing - INPUT "NEMA L6-30 PLUG", "10FT 10AWG / 3C POWERCORD"; INPUT RATING "200-240V~", "2W+PE", "24A", "50/60HZ". The cord is fixed. `input-plug` is the slug the cord exports, `nema-l6-30p`.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S SPECIFICATION DRAWING, MEASURED, NOT DIMENSIONED. Eaton EMIT04-10 ("ePDU G3 SPECIFICATION DRAWING FOR EMIT04-10", part EMI3MTB5JDQ13A1, revision 002, 21 Jan 2016, one D-size sheet) is a vector sheet that dimensions only the overall: 482.6 [19.00] wide, 42.9 [1.69] high and 203.2 [8.00] deep. Every other figure was read off a 300 dpi render against the 482.6, 9.45 px per mm, good to about 0.5 mm. The sheet says "DO NOT SCALE DRAWING". It has the same four views as the EMIT03-10's sheet, and THE CORD FACE IS TURNED HALF A TURN ON THE SHEET (its labels are upside down) and is drawn here as it stands, seen from behind. No photograph of this model is held. The brochure (Rack PDU G3+, BR155022EN, 2019, EMEA) has two small photographs of 1U horizontal G3+ units on its page 3 (their model numbers are not printed) and larger ones of vertical units on page 2; they show the meter module, the buttons, the display and the section colours, and are the colour reference here, not photographs of this model.

module.note: drawing and datasheet - the same meter module as the EMIT03-10's (see its provenance; the product overview PA155003EN calls it hot-swappable); not modelled as a bay (gaps: meter-module-bay).

outlets.note: drawing - "OUTPUT (8) IEC 60320 C13 GRIP, (4) IEC 60320 C19 GRIP", OUTPUT RATING "200-240V~; 15A PER C13; 16A PER C19; 16A MAX PER SECTION; 24A MAX TOTAL". A1 to A4 are the C13s of section A, A5 and A6 its C19s; B1 to B4 the C13s of section B, B5 and B6 its C19s. Only the C19s' labels and the ends of each C13 run are printed (B4 and B1, A4 and A3); the other C13s take their numbers from the run, which the sheet's order of printing implies and does not state (gaps: outlet-numbers). C13s are drawn with the earth slot to the right on the controls face and, turned half a turn on the sheet, to the left as drawn there, which is to the right as they stand seen from behind; the C19s have their earth slot up on the sheet and so down as they stand.

rear.note: drawing - the cord face, seen from behind, so x runs the other way from the front: mm from the left as seen from behind. The cord gland (32.8 across flats, 37.9 across corners) centred 36.6 across. Then A3 and A4 (C13, yellow block, 63.6 to 115.3) centred 77.0 and 102.2; B1 to B4 (C13, blue block, 121.7 to 222.2) centred 134.7, 159.4, 184.4 and 208.9; then four C19, A5 and A6 (yellow) and B5 and B6 (blue), each in its own edged plate 47.9 wide, centred 252.6, 304.1, 354.0 and 404.9. The C13s are centred 17.4 down and the C19s 23.9 down. Screws 6.2 from each end. THE DRAWN OUTLET FACES ARE NARROWER THAN THE PARTS: the C19 well reads 32.5 across where std/c19-outlet@1 is 35.6, and the part is placed on the drawn centre.
